voiceScript: Myth: biometric data only matters to technical people. Biometric Data means the real-world choices, risks, and protections involved in biometric data. Picture this: a phone owner encounters biometric data during a normal day and must decide whether to trust a request, setting, or device. Here is why that matters: a rushed biometric data choice can expose information, interrupt access, or give the wrong person an opening. Check the source and the specific biometric data setting before continuing. Use the available biometric data protection and ask a trusted person or IT support when its details do not make sense.
